# @demodev-ui/react

> CSS-only design system built on HeroUI v3. This package has NO component exports. All React components come from `@heroui/react`. This package only provides style overrides via a single CSS import.

## Install

```bash
npm install @demodev-ui/react @heroui/react@3.0.1 @heroui/styles@3.0.1 tailwindcss@^4 @tailwindcss/vite
```

## Claude Code Setup

Install and set up AI context in one command:
```bash
npm install @demodev-ui/react @heroui/react@3.0.1 @heroui/styles@3.0.1 tailwindcss@^4 @tailwindcss/vite && echo -e '\n## @demodev-ui/react\nThis project uses @demodev-ui/react (CSS-only design system on HeroUI v3).\nAll components are imported from `@heroui/react`, NOT from `@demodev-ui/react`.\nFor full component API and usage examples, read `node_modules/@demodev-ui/react/llms.txt`.' >> CLAUDE.md
```

## Setup

CSS entry file (import order matters):
```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "@heroui/styles";
@import "@demodev-ui/react/styles";
@source "../node_modules/@heroui/react/dist";
```

Vite config:
```ts
import tailwindcss from "@tailwindcss/vite";
export default defineConfig({ plugins: [tailwindcss(), react()] });
```

App root — must include Toast.Provider:
```tsx
<div className="min-h-screen bg-background text-foreground">
  {/* app */}
  <Toast.Provider />
</div>
```

## Critical Rules

### 1. Import source
```tsx
// CORRECT — always import from @heroui/react
import { Button, Input, Modal } from "@heroui/react";
// WRONG — @demodev-ui/react has NO component exports
import { Button } from "@demodev-ui/react"; // ❌ does not exist
```

### 2. Collection components must be inside their parent
Runtime crash if rendered outside collection context:
- ListBox.Item → inside <ListBox>
- Tag → inside <TagGroup.List>
- Dropdown.Item → inside <Dropdown.Menu>
- Tabs.Tab → inside <Tabs.List>

### 3. Trigger button nesting
Some Triggers render their own <button>. Nesting <Button> inside creates invalid HTML:
- Modal.Trigger → renders <div> → ✅ can contain <Button>
- AlertDialog.Trigger → renders <div> → ✅ can contain <Button>
- Dropdown.Trigger → renders <div> → ✅ can contain <Button>
- Tooltip.Trigger → renders <button> → ❌ use <span> as child
- ComboBox.Trigger → renders <button> → ❌

### 4. Button color via data attribute
Button has no `color` prop. Use `data-color` for outline/ghost variants:
```tsx
<Button variant="outline" data-color="accent">Accent</Button>
// Available: "accent" | "danger" | "success" | "warning"
```

## Components

All imports: `import { ComponentName } from "@heroui/react";`

### Button
- Variants: "primary" | "secondary" | "outline" | "ghost" | "danger" | "danger-soft" | "tertiary"
- Sizes: "sm" | "md" | "lg"
- Props: variant, size, isIconOnly, isDisabled, data-color (for outline/ghost)
```tsx
<Button variant="primary" size="md">Click</Button>
<Button variant="outline" data-color="danger">Danger</Button>
<Button size="sm" isIconOnly>+</Button>
```

### ButtonGroup
- Props: orientation ("horizontal" | "vertical"), size
```tsx
<ButtonGroup>
  <Button>Left</Button>
  <ButtonGroup.Separator />
  <Button>Right</Button>
</ButtonGroup>
```

### Input
- Variants: "primary" | "secondary"
```tsx
<Input placeholder="Text" variant="primary" />
```

### TextField
- Compound: TextField > Label + Input + Description
```tsx
<TextField variant="primary" isRequired>
  <Label>Email</Label>
  <Input placeholder="you@example.com" />
  <Description>Helper text</Description>
</TextField>
```

### InputGroup
- Compound: InputGroup > Prefix/Suffix + Input
```tsx
<InputGroup variant="primary">
  <InputGroup.Prefix>https://</InputGroup.Prefix>
  <InputGroup.Input placeholder="example.com" />
</InputGroup>
```

### TextArea
- Use inside TextField
```tsx
<TextField variant="primary">
  <Label>Message</Label>
  <TextArea placeholder="Type..." />
</TextField>
```

### NumberField
```tsx
<NumberField variant="primary" defaultValue={5} minValue={0} maxValue={100}>
  <Label>Qty</Label>
  <NumberField.Group>
    <NumberField.DecrementButton>-</NumberField.DecrementButton>
    <NumberField.Input />
    <NumberField.IncrementButton>+</NumberField.IncrementButton>
  </NumberField.Group>
</NumberField>
```

### SearchField
```tsx
<SearchField variant="primary">
  <Label>Search</Label>
  <SearchField.Group>
    <SearchField.SearchIcon />
    <SearchField.Input placeholder="Search..." />
    <SearchField.ClearButton />
  </SearchField.Group>
</SearchField>
```

### ComboBox
```tsx
<ComboBox variant="primary">
  <Label>Fruit</Label>
  <ComboBox.InputGroup>
    <Input placeholder="Select..." />
    <ComboBox.Trigger />
  </ComboBox.InputGroup>
  <ComboBox.Popover>
    <ListBox>
      <ListBox.Item id="apple" textValue="Apple">
        Apple
        <ListBox.ItemIndicator />
      </ListBox.Item>
    </ListBox>
  </ComboBox.Popover>
</ComboBox>
```

### Select
- Variants: "primary" | "secondary"
```tsx
<Select variant="primary">
  <Label>Country</Label>
  <Select.Trigger>
    <Select.Value>Select</Select.Value>
    <Select.Indicator />
  </Select.Trigger>
  <Select.Popover>
    <ListBox>
      <ListBox.Item id="kr" textValue="Korea">
        Korea
        <ListBox.ItemIndicator />
      </ListBox.Item>
    </ListBox>
  </Select.Popover>
</Select>
```

### Checkbox
- Variants: "primary" | "secondary"
```tsx
<Checkbox variant="primary" id="terms">
  <Checkbox.Control />
  <Checkbox.Content>
    <Label>Accept terms</Label>
    <Description>You agree to the terms</Description>
  </Checkbox.Content>
</Checkbox>
```

### RadioGroup
```tsx
<RadioGroup variant="primary" defaultValue="opt1">
  <Label>Choose</Label>
  <Radio value="opt1">
    <Radio.Control><Radio.Indicator /></Radio.Control>
    <Radio.Content><Label>Option 1</Label></Radio.Content>
  </Radio>
  <Radio value="opt2">
    <Radio.Control><Radio.Indicator /></Radio.Control>
    <Radio.Content><Label>Option 2</Label></Radio.Content>
  </Radio>
</RadioGroup>
```

### ToggleButton
- Variants: "default" | "ghost"
- Sizes: "sm" | "md" | "lg"
```tsx
<ToggleButton size="md" variant="default">Toggle</ToggleButton>
```

### ToggleButtonGroup
- selectionMode: "single" | "multiple"
- isDetached: boolean (detached style)
```tsx
<ToggleButtonGroup selectionMode="single" defaultSelectedKeys={["bold"]}>
  <ToggleButton id="bold">B</ToggleButton>
  <ToggleButton id="italic">I</ToggleButton>
</ToggleButtonGroup>
```

### Tag + TagGroup
- Tag MUST be inside TagGroup.List
- Sizes: "sm" | "md" | "lg"
- Variants: "default" | "surface"
```tsx
<TagGroup selectionMode="multiple">
  <Label>Tags</Label>
  <TagGroup.List>
    <Tag id="t1" size="sm">Tag 1</Tag>
    <Tag id="t2" size="md">Tag 2</Tag>
  </TagGroup.List>
</TagGroup>

// Removable
<TagGroup onRemove={(keys) => {}}>
  <TagGroup.List>
    <Tag id="r1">Tag<Tag.RemoveButton /></Tag>
  </TagGroup.List>
</TagGroup>
```

### Chip
- Variants: "primary" | "secondary" | "tertiary"
- Sizes: "sm" | "md" | "lg"
- Colors: "accent" | "success" | "warning" | "danger"
```tsx
<Chip size="md" variant="primary" color="accent"><Chip.Label>Accent</Chip.Label></Chip>
```

### Modal
- Modal.Trigger renders <div> → safe to put <Button> inside
- Container sizes: "sm" | "md" | "lg"
```tsx
<Modal>
  <Modal.Trigger><Button variant="outline">Open</Button></Modal.Trigger>
  <Modal.Backdrop />
  <Modal.Container size="md">
    <Modal.Dialog>
      <Modal.Header>
        <Modal.Heading>Title</Modal.Heading>
        <Modal.CloseTrigger />
      </Modal.Header>
      <Modal.Body><p>Content</p></Modal.Body>
      <Modal.Footer>
        <Button variant="ghost">Cancel</Button>
        <Button variant="primary">Confirm</Button>
      </Modal.Footer>
    </Modal.Dialog>
  </Modal.Container>
</Modal>
```

### AlertDialog
- AlertDialog.Trigger renders <div> → safe to put <Button> inside
- AlertDialog.Icon status: "danger" | "success" | "warning"
```tsx
<AlertDialog>
  <AlertDialog.Trigger><Button variant="danger">Delete</Button></AlertDialog.Trigger>
  <AlertDialog.Backdrop />
  <AlertDialog.Container size="sm">
    <AlertDialog.Dialog>
      <AlertDialog.Header>
        <AlertDialog.Icon status="danger" />
        <AlertDialog.Heading>Delete?</AlertDialog.Heading>
      </AlertDialog.Header>
      <AlertDialog.Body>This cannot be undone.</AlertDialog.Body>
      <AlertDialog.Footer>
        <Button variant="ghost">Cancel</Button>
        <Button variant="danger">Delete</Button>
      </AlertDialog.Footer>
    </AlertDialog.Dialog>
  </AlertDialog.Container>
</AlertDialog>
```

### Dropdown
- Dropdown.Trigger renders <div> → safe to put <Button> inside
```tsx
<Dropdown>
  <Dropdown.Trigger>
    <Button variant="outline">Menu</Button>
  </Dropdown.Trigger>
  <Dropdown.Popover>
    <Dropdown.Menu onAction={(key) => console.log(key)}>
      <Dropdown.Item id="edit">Edit</Dropdown.Item>
      <Dropdown.Item id="delete">Delete</Dropdown.Item>
    </Dropdown.Menu>
  </Dropdown.Popover>
</Dropdown>
```

### Tooltip
- ❌ Tooltip.Trigger IS a <button> — use <span> as child, not <Button>
```tsx
<Tooltip>
  <Tooltip.Trigger><span>Hover me</span></Tooltip.Trigger>
  <Tooltip.Content showArrow>Tooltip text</Tooltip.Content>
</Tooltip>
```

### Toast
- Add <Toast.Provider /> once at app root
```tsx
Toast.toast("Message")
Toast.toast.success("Done!")
Toast.toast.danger("Error!")
Toast.toast.warning("Warning!")
```

### Tabs
```tsx
<Tabs variant="primary">
  <Tabs.List>
    <Tabs.Tab id="tab1">Tab 1</Tabs.Tab>
    <Tabs.Tab id="tab2">Tab 2</Tabs.Tab>
  </Tabs.List>
  <Tabs.Panel id="tab1">Content 1</Tabs.Panel>
  <Tabs.Panel id="tab2">Content 2</Tabs.Panel>
</Tabs>
```

### Pagination
- Sizes: "sm" | "md" | "lg"
```tsx
<Pagination size="md">
  <Pagination.Content>
    <Pagination.Item><Pagination.Previous><Pagination.PreviousIcon /></Pagination.Previous></Pagination.Item>
    <Pagination.Item><Pagination.Link isActive>1</Pagination.Link></Pagination.Item>
    <Pagination.Item><Pagination.Link>2</Pagination.Link></Pagination.Item>
    <Pagination.Item><Pagination.Ellipsis /></Pagination.Item>
    <Pagination.Item><Pagination.Link>10</Pagination.Link></Pagination.Item>
    <Pagination.Item><Pagination.Next><Pagination.NextIcon /></Pagination.Next></Pagination.Item>
  </Pagination.Content>
</Pagination>
```

### Slider
```tsx
<Slider defaultValue={50} minValue={0} maxValue={100}>
  <div className="flex justify-between">
    <Label>Volume</Label>
    <Slider.Output />
  </div>
  <Slider.Track>
    <Slider.Fill />
    <Slider.Thumb />
  </Slider.Track>
</Slider>

// Range
<Slider defaultValue={[20, 80]} minValue={0} maxValue={100}>
  <Slider.Track><Slider.Fill /><Slider.Thumb /><Slider.Thumb /></Slider.Track>
</Slider>
```

### Alert
- Status: "default" | "accent" | "success" | "warning" | "danger"
```tsx
<Alert status="success">
  <Alert.Indicator />
  <Alert.Content>
    <Alert.Title>Success</Alert.Title>
    <Alert.Description>Action completed.</Alert.Description>
  </Alert.Content>
</Alert>
```

### CloseButton
```tsx
<CloseButton variant="default" onPress={() => {}} />
```

## Design Tokens

Colors:
- Gray scale: --color-gray-50 ~ --color-gray-900
- Semantic: --accent (#2d64fa), --danger (#ef1026), --success (#1fa24e), --warning (#f6c205), --info (#1571f3)
- Surface: --border (gray-200), --default (gray-50)

Border radius:
- Button: --radius-button-xs(md) / sm(lg) / md(0.625rem) / lg(xl)
- Chip: --radius-chip-sm(md) / md(lg)
- Input: --radius-input-lg(xl)
- ListBox: --radius-list-box(xl)
- Toast: --radius-toast(2xl)

Component heights:
- Button: --spacing-button-sm(36px) / md(40px) / lg(48px)
- Chip: --spacing-chip-sm(24px) / md(32px) / lg(36px)
- Input: --spacing-input-lg(48px)
